using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Amazon.DynamoDBv2;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Orleans.Configuration;

namespace Orleans.Storage
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configuration options for DynamoDBGrainStorage.
    /// </summary>
    public class DynamoDBStorageOptions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// The name of the DynamoDB table to use for storing grain state.
        /// </summary>
        public string TableName { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The AWS service to use for DynamoDB.
        /// </summary>
        public string Service { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The AWS access key to use for DynamoDB.
        /// </summary>
        public string AccessKey { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The AWS secret key to use for DynamoDB.
        /// </summary>
        public string SecretKey { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The AWS session token to use for DynamoDB.
        /// </summary>
        public string Token { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The AWS profile name to use for DynamoDB.
        /// </summary>
        public string ProfileName { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The read capacity units for the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public long ReadCapacityUnits { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The write capacity units for the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public long WriteCapacityUnits { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether to use provisioned throughput for the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public bool UseProvisionedThroughput { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether to create the DynamoDB table if it does not exist.
        /// </summary>
        public bool CreateIfNotExists { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether to update the DynamoDB table if it already exists.
        /// </summary>
        public bool UpdateIfExists { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The time to live for grain state in the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public TimeSpan? TimeToLive { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// The service ID for the DynamoDB table.
        /// </summary>
        public string ServiceId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Whether to delete state on clear.
        /// </summary>
        public bool DeleteStateOnClear { get; set; }
    }
}

using Orleans.Storage;
using System;

public class DynamoDBGrainStorageFactoryTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void Create_WithValidServiceProvider_ReturnsDynamoDBGrainStorage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var serviceProvider = new ServiceCollection()
            .AddOptions<DynamoDBStorageOptions>()
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        var optionsMonitor = Mock.Of<IOptionsMonitor<DynamoDBStorageOptions>>();
        serviceProvider.GetService<IOptionsMonitor<DynamoDBStorageOptions>>().Returns(optionsMonitor);

        var name = "TestName";

        // Act
        var result = DynamoDBGrainStorageFactory.Create(serviceProvider, name);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotNull(result);
        Assert.IsType<DynamoDBGrainStorage>(result);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Create_WithNullServiceProvider_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Act and Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => DynamoDBGrainStorageFactory.Create(null, "TestName"));
    }

    public void Create_WithNullName_ThrowsArgumentNullException()
    {
        // Arrange

            .AddOptions<DynamoDBStorageOptions>()
            .BuildServiceProvider();

        // Act and Assert

    }
